userStatement: revives don't need an expiration timer btw, we won't make them spawn with a timer. they'll last until they die, the necro dies or they're replaced
scope: Revive lifetime only. AI, combat, status-effect and other functional event timers remain independent. The pinned source tables retain their original duration as reference data; the approved Sanctuary rule takes precedence. This decision does not certify a complete learned Revive actor.
